label: Gödel's 1970 axiom Ax3: at every world, NECESSARY_EXISTENCE_7 in the 1970 sense is POSITIVE_1
paraphrase: Gödel's 1970 axiom Ax3 (AFP GoedelVariantHOML1.thy): at every world, necessary existence in the 1970 sense (each essence of the individual, in the 1970 sense, is necessarily exemplified by an existing individual) is positive.
